title: Figures can be applied from a stale read, and trade settlement writes the book under the engine's lock
evidence: rust/crates/server/src/figures.rs:420-428 (`pulled`, which `record_changed` at :411-413 now delegates to): the inputs are read before the lock — `:421 let book = self.book()?;` `:422 let ledger = engine_inputs::ledger(&book)?;` `:423 let adjustments = engine_inputs::facts(&book)?.adjustments;` `:426 brokers.insert(*a, engine_inputs::broker_account(*a, &book.stated(*a)...)?);` and only then `:428 let mut guard = self.engine.write().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());` with the stale reads applied under it at `:436 e.apply(Change::Trades(ledger.trades.clone()))`, `:445 e.apply(Change::Ledger(ledger))`, `:448 e.apply(Change::Adjustments(adjustments))`, `:453 e.apply(Change::Broker(a, now_stated))`. No version is checked at apply. The book is still written under the engine's write lock: `:450 merge(&mut moved, settle_trades(&book, e, now)?);` and `settle_trades` (:74-119) calls `:95 book.move_trade(...)`, `:99 book.open_trade(...)`, `:103 book.orphan_joined(...)`, `:108 book.orphan_unclaimed(...)`. `broker_changed` (:467-481) has the same shape: `:468 let now = self.book()?.stated_latest(account)...` read before `:469 let mut guard = self.engine.write()...`. The only change since 4d102be9 (commit 93a0dca3) renamed `record_changed` to `pulled`, narrowed the broker read to `stated_for` accounts and rewrote `broker_changed` to take the lock explicitly; neither adds a version check nor moves the reads under the lock, and no concurrency test (two changes applied together equal one rebuild) exists in the test module (:555-770).
note: The issue's line references shifted by ~9 lines (411-416 → 420-428, 436 → 450) after commit 93a0dca3 split record_changed into record_changed/pulled; the defect itself is untouched.
